evidence_classes.DECODED DATA: ROM tables/records decoded by a parser
evidence_classes.BYTE-VERIFIED ASSEMBLY: routine bytes compared literally and disassembled by hand
evidence_classes.SOURCE-TRACED BEHAVIOR: behavior read from the disassembly, not executed
evidence_classes.CONTROLLED ROUTINE RESULT: original routine executed on a Z80 core with explicit RAM
evidence_classes.EMULATED ORIGINAL FRAME: whole original game run in the approximate SMS harness

type_26.gameplay_anchor: object +$11/+$12 (X) and +$14/+$15 (Y); placement X is used unchanged; Y is placement Y + 12 after $825A (rest position)
type_26.contact_window: player anchor Y in [restY - 33, restY - 28] = [placementY - 21, placementY - 16]; |dx| < 12; floor-standing Sonic has anchor Y = floorSurface - 18 which is placementY - 18 when the floor surface is at the placement Y (verified for the THZ1 control placements)
type_26.mapping_anchor: mapping $91C0 frame records are drawn relative to the same object coordinates (docs/mapped-object-screen-registration.md: rows -6..+17 for frame 2); at rest the object sits 12 px below the placement Y, so the dormant frame is mostly below the floor line
type_26.animation: the extension raises the OBJECT Y 7 px per update (+$14), 4 updates = 28 px (rest -> placementY - 16); contact is not evaluated in states 1..6, so the moving art never feeds back into collision
type_26.poc_guidance: keep the contact window and X rule on the placement-derived rest anchor; do not derive them from the sprite's visible top (it changes with the frame and extension) or the GameMaker mask

terrain_springs.gameplay_anchor: layout cell + collision header profile only; the visible spring art is ordinary background tiles with no separate object
terrain_springs.probe: upright/diagonal: (X, Y+18); horizontal: (X+-9, Y+6); ceiling: (X, Y-6)

type_26.spring_flight_0B_1C: evaluated; Y speed must be non-negative so a launch cannot restart during the rise
type_26.forced_transition: $480C requests $0B from ANY state whenever the gates pass (it only checks the Y-speed sign), overriding loop/twist/act-clear requests; velocity is overwritten (vy only)

terrain_upright_diagonal_horizontal_ceil.gate: current state $11 blocks upright/diagonal/horizontal; the ceiling bounce has no state gate
terrain_upright_diagonal_horizontal_ceil.loop_states_0C_0D_13_and_twist_22_and_20: not evaluated: these states never call $690B (terrain-ring state reach)

d448.reader: ROM $3018F (bank $0C, CPU $818F): LD A,($D448); RRCA; RET - used only by the FF 08 condition at the head of the state $0B animation script
d448.state_0b_entry_guarantee: $480C is the only code that requests state $0B and every caller ($6A8D, $5F21 through vector $035F from $82FB/$8423/$99D0/$B2D2) writes $D448 first; a stale value is therefore never observed
d448.meaning: bit 0 only chooses the animation fragment of state $0B when the script is (re)started: set -> hold frame $61 (duration 4, repeating); clear -> frames $1C..$21 cycle. It affects presentation and the animation counter values, nothing else
d448.does_not_affect: velocity, gravity, apex/landing decisions, controls, collision, attack posture ($D503), damage, terrain-ring parity (docs/player-animation-counter.md sect. 10)
d448.distinction: strong ($FF): terrain upright, type $26 parameter 0 / aux1 = 0 span, type $21 stomp; weak ($00): type $26 nonzero parameter, boss bounce; diagonal writes 0 but enters $1C which has no D448 reader
d448.persistence: never cleared by landing, act start or the diagonal spring ($1C does not read it); zeroed only by the boot/reset RAM clears; persistence across acts is irrelevant because of the guarantee above

state_reach.evidence: EMULATED ORIGINAL FRAME + SOURCE-TRACED BEHAVIOR (reused from terrain-ring-collection.json)
state_reach.meaning: the terrain probe $753E sits inside $690B; a state that never calls it never runs $690B, so terrain springs (and the ceiling/side special tiles) cannot trigger in it

state_reach.evidence: SOURCE-TRACED BEHAVIOR (static reachability over CALL/JP/JR; indirect jumps are not followed)

type26_geometry.horizontal_rule: abs(playerX - objectX) < 12 (strict; $0383 -> $61A5 compares |dx| < BC with BC=12)
type26_geometry.vertical_rule: 0 <= (objectY - 28) - playerY < 6, i.e. playerY in [objectY-33, objectY-28] inclusive (unsigned 16-bit subtracts at $82DD/$82E4)
type26_geometry.coordinates: player anchor (D511/D514) versus the object's current +$11/+$14; object rest Y = placement Y + 12 (init $825A); no extents, mask or sprite edge involved

type26_gates.vy_rule: Y speed high byte bit 7 set (negative) rejects; zero and every positive value pass; low byte irrelevant ($D519 bit 7 tested at $82B4)
type26_gates.floor_rule: $D522 bit 1 must be set (floor/object contact flag of the previous player update); other bits irrelevant
type26_gates.state_rule: ONLY the requested state $D502 == $21 blocks; the current state $D501 is not read. All 64 values of each swept
type26_gates.object_flags_rule: +$04 bit 6 set (object inactive: created with $40 ORed in by $80EB, cleared when the object is awake) rejects; other bits irrelevant

type26_span.x_rule: x0 <= playerX < x0 + span (x0 = placement X restored from +$3A/+$3B each update; span = (parameter & $7F) * 16); no |dx|<12 rule
type26_span.y_rule: abs(objectY - playerY) < $30 (strict; $0386 -> $61B1 with BC=$30), objectY = placement Y + 12
type26_span.gate_rule: same as state 7: Y speed not negative, floor flag, requested state != $21
type26_span.state9_note: playerX & $FFF0 becomes the spring X; launch values are selected by +$3F; D448 and the extension state are written even when $480C then rejects a negative Y speed (checked below)

semantics.bit7_clear: fixed spring; +$3F is the raw parameter: 0 -> strong (-7.375, D448=$FF, extension state 1); nonzero -> weak (-5.0, D448=0); extension state 3 only when the parameter is exactly 1, otherwise state 1 (animation only); the low seven bits are otherwise not read
semantics.bit7_set: concealed span: span = (parameter & $7F) * 16 px starting at the placement X; +$3F is overwritten with 1 (weak) when aux1 (+$09) is nonzero, 0 (strong) when aux1 is zero; every canonical record has aux1 = $72, so span springs are always weak
semantics.other: aux1 only matters for span springs (strength) and for the post-launch extension state of state-9 launches (3 when nonzero, 1 when zero); no parameter changes orientation: type $26 is upright only

type26_state_matrix.meaning: type $26 contact is player-state agnostic except requested state $21; loop states $0C/$0D/$13, twist $22, act-clear $20, rolling, jumping and falling all pass the gate

rules: current state $D501 == $11 rejects; every other current state passes (including $0B and $1C: a spring can re-trigger inside its own flight once vy >= 0)
requested state is not read by the terrain handlers
Y speed high byte negative rejects; zero passes ($6A80: LD A,(IX+$19); AND A; RET M)
upright: floor flag required by the handler ($6A7B); diagonal: same ($6A9A)
diagonal: X speed, facing bit (+4 bit 4) and $D448 are written BEFORE the Y-speed gate of $482D, so a negative Y speed leaves state and Y unchanged but still sets X speed, facing, D448 and sound
no floor-flag, Y-speed or requested-state gate; only current state != $11 (the spring tail tests $D501 == $11 at $7204/$72AA)

activation is the ordinary side projection: the side probe point (X +- 9, Y + 6) must lie inside the block's solid horizontal profile and the projection must be non-zero; the launch is applied after the projection moved Sonic out of the wall
left-half blocks $32/$33: solid columns 0..15 of the cell, rows 8..27; right-half $34/$35: columns 16..31, rows 8..27 (profile bit 6 flips the side)
right probe launches X = -6.0 ($FA00) via $4868; left probe launches X = +6.0 ($0600) via $4849; Y speed untouched; $D448 untouched; speed cap $D373 = $0600

terrain_ceiling.note: blocks $3A/$3B appear in no THZ1/THZ2/THZ3 layout cell (layout scan); type $15 ($748F: Y +7.5 down, no X) has no THZ block either

bounce_blocks.gate: BIT 1,(IX+3) must be set (the rolling/attack flag $D503 bit 1) and the current state must not be $0F/$10/$15/$1A; then vy = $FBC0 (-4.25), airborne set, floor cleared and the block is replaced ($7857 -> $46, $7898 -> $9D)
bounce_blocks.relevance: upright-spring flight has $D503 bit 1 clear (cannot break these); the diagonal spring ($1C) and horizontal spring (state 9) have it set

vx=+4.0; facing bit +4.4 cleared; D448=0; sound $A6; Y = $F900 (-7.0) because $D297 == 0
state 9; vx=-6.0; cap=$0600; +3 bit 0 clear, bit 1 set; Y speed untouched

NOT gated: horizontal springs launch regardless of Y speed

summary.$480C: request $0B; vy = HL (unconditional: not additive, not clamped, independent of incoming speed and of the spring strength path); +3 bit 0 set, bit 1 CLEAR; +$22 bit 1 (floor) cleared; vx, facing, speed cap untouched; rejected (nothing written) when the Y speed is negative
summary.$482D: request $1C; vy = HL; +3 bits 0 AND 1 set (airborne + rolling/attack); floor cleared; vx and facing are written by the caller $6A90 before the gate; rejected when the Y speed is negative
summary.$4849/$4868: request 9 (rolling); vx = +-6.0 and speed cap $D373 = $0600; +3 bit 0 CLEAR, bit 1 set (grounded roll); floor flag cleared; Y speed untouched; no Y-speed gate
summary.position: no spring snaps Sonic's position beyond the ordinary terrain projection that precedes it; the type $26 span form moves the OBJECT X to playerX & $FFF0

attack_state.rule: badnik callbacks test the player's movement flag $D503 bit 1 (the rolling/attack posture) - and for types $27/$21/$50 also power-up $D532 == 6 - never the player state number and never 'airborne' ($D503 bit 0); type $21 additionally resolves top contact (objectY - 4 >= playerY) as a stomp bounce BEFORE the attack test

death_boundary.rule: death ($4984: state $1F, vy -5.0, $D293 bit 2) iff signed screen Y ($D51C = playerY - cameraY, computed by $3FC8) is non-negative and >= $D0 (208); negative values (above the camera) are never fatal; the dying-state check at $3C09 uses $D8

emulated_flights.method: THZ1 booted in tools/sms_frame_harness.py, Sonic teleported with the camera, spring objects force-created ($D440 = 0); PC hook at the player callback entry $5E91 records +$01,+$02,+$03,speeds,flags,$D448,$D373
emulated_flights.flag_reading: f3 = $D503: bit0 airborne, bit1 rolling/attack posture. Spring flights: upright ($0B/$0E) f3=1 (NOT attacking); diagonal $1C f3=3 (attacking) until the apex request $0E clears bit 1; horizontal state 9 f3=2 (attacking, grounded roll); normal jump $0A f3=3; roll 9 f3=2; a jump (f3=3) that lands on the upright spring becomes $0B with f3=1 (the spring clears the attack posture)

emulated_placements.note: apex_y is the lowest world Y within the launch state plus 40 updates; a chain onto another spring can lift a later apex, so the first-launch apex is the comparable figure

emulated_top_of_screen.method: THZ1, Sonic at (2470,120); Y speed forced to -8.0 on every player update for 200 updates (an artificial thrust far beyond any spring; the engine moves him to $0E)
emulated_top_of_screen.reading: the camera stops at its top limit (8); world Y wraps below zero as an unsigned 16-bit value; screen Y goes arbitrarily negative; no death, no clamp, no state change
